[[File:Six_Virtues_Theed.png|thumb|right|250px|The Six Virtues in the frontcourt of the Theed Royal Palace.]]
'''Fasano Eckener''' was a legendary sculptor who created the [[Six Virtues/Legends|Six Virtues]] statues that stood in the frontcourt of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] around [[532 BBY/Legends|532 BBY]]<ref name="EXPVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>.

==Behind the scenes==
Fasano Eckener was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]. He shares a surname with the [[Chief Architect/Legends|Chief Architect]] of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] member, [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]].
